history.text: Hi Tomas, this is the AI assistant answering this phone. How can I help?
Hey! How are you doing today? Busy day on the phones? Anyway, could you tell the owner I'll bring the drill back on Friday.

expect.outcome: Answers the small talk in a word or two at most, takes the message about the drill and says it will be passed on. Friendly; does not treat the caller as off topic and does not end the call abruptly.
